text:
Ravi (Events): Quick sync for Oslo DevNight booth 1 — final items: swag pickup time, slide check, QR lead tags, and post-event webinar RSVP flow. Who owns?

Maya (Marketing): I can own webinar RSVP + onsite signage. Need the per-session QR shortcodes by Tue.

Theo (Logistics): Swag pickup confirmed with courier on 2025-08-05 14:00. Manifest attached to drive. Customs note: need commercial invoice + local importer VAT.

Priya (Growth): For lead tags: propose 'oslo_webinar', 'oslo_demo', 'oslo_enterprise'. We'll map QR shortcodes -> tag. High intent flagged if they select demo.

Ravi (Events): Slide check window = 8/06 09:00-10:00 internal. slides-bot 1: please ping speakers 8/04 if slides not in.

slides-bot: Reminder scheduled: Speakers missing slides: 3. Auto-reminder set for 2025-08-04 09:00.

Maya (Marketing): Onsite postcard copy for webinar signups: short blurb + QR. I'll upload print file by 8/03. Designer please confirm bleed.

Theo (Logistics): Small ask: can we reduce tees by 20%? Budget reallocation suggests more postcards + stickers.

Priya (Growth): OK to reduce tees. Increase postcards to 600 and stickers to 1400.

Ravi (Events): I'll reserve a 30-min green room and add a laptop for live demo. Also ordering 1 spare demo laptop.

Maya (Marketing): Post-event nurture: 24h thank-you + replay link, 72h invite to deeper webinar, 5d AE outreach for demo tag. I'll draft templates.

Theo (Logistics): ETA notes: manifest final by 8/03 or customs delays. I'll email procurement for importer VAT.

Ravi (Events): Owners: swag/logistics -> Theo, webinar + postal assets -> Maya, lead mapping -> Priya, slides review -> Ravi. Agreed?

All: Agreed.

Maya (Marketing): I'll post a short runbook in the event folder after this thread. Keep replies minimal here. :thumbsup:
